Message.MsgText: The 'configFile' parameter must be set to use the GLA Connector.

Explanation.p: The required parameter configFile is not set in the GLA Connector.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify the path to the adapter configuration file in the configFile parameter.

Message.MsgText: The adapter configuration file is not valid: exception message.

Explanation.p: The given configuration file is not valid. See the exception message for more information.

OperatorResponse.p: Correct the adapter configuration file and try again.

Message.MsgText: The adapter configuration file is validated.
The adapter configuration file is started.
The execution of the adapter configuration file failed: Exception message

Explanation.p: An Exception occurred during the execution of the adapter configuration file. See the Exception message for more information.

OperatorResponse.p: See the Exception message for more information.

Message.MsgText: There is no registered GLAConnector matching the specified in the TDIOutputter 'tdi_correlation_id' parameter: Correlation ID.

Explanation.p: The Hashtable of the TDIOutputter does not contain a Connector registered to the specified 'tdi_correlation_id'.

OperatorResponse.p: Specify a correct value in the TDIOutputter 'tdi_correlation_id' parameter.

Message.MsgText: There are more than one configured TDIOutputters in the adapter configuration file.

Explanation.p: The GLAConnector allows only one TDIOutputter to be configured in the adapter configuration file.

OperatorResponse.p: Put only one TDIOutputter in the adapter configuration file.

Message.MsgText: An exception occurred while converting the XML file to Document object: exception message

Explanation.p: There are several possible reasons for this exception. A DocumentBuilder may not have been able to be created which satisfied the configuration requested. An IO error occurred. Or, a parse error occurred.

OperatorResponse.p: See the Exception message for more information.

Message.MsgText: The given adapter configuration file does not have a configured TDIOutputter.

Explanation.p: The GLAConnector needs a TDIOutputter to be configured in the adapter configuration file in order to receive the CBE objects.

OperatorResponse.p: Set a TDIOutputter in the adapter configuration file and try again. Refer to the GLAConnector documentation about how to configure the TDIOutputter.
